relationships.subject: LC/E-BoNT/A
relationships.evidence_quote: The most notable finding is that a single injection of LC/E-BoNT/A induced a long-lasting anti-nociceptive effect, as evidenced by a suppression of the acute nocifensive behavior evoked by capsaicin.

relationships.subject: LC/E-BoNT/A

key_findings: A single whisker pad injection of LC/E-BoNT/A suppressed capsaicin-evoked nocifensive behavior for up to 15 days and reduced TNC c-Fos without systemic toxicity.
In trigeminal neurons, the chimeras inhibited CGRP release at all capsaicin concentrations, whereas BoNT/A failed at 1 uM capsaicin.
